Interface CoinflipAPI

public interface CoinflipAPI
Coinflip rooms, for other plugins. Get it with get() (null while Coinflip is not running). 
CoinflipAPI flips = CoinflipAPI.get();
flips.registerMode(new MyItemsMode());                    // in your setup(); unregister in shutdown()
CoinflipAPI.Result made = flips.create(player, "coins_1v1", Bet.coins(500, Side.HEADS));
flips.listen(new CoinflipAPI.Listener() {
    public void finished(Room room) { ... room.winner().name() ... }
});
Everything here may be called from any thread.
